extracted.intended_audience: Reuters journalists, editors and newsroom staff
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational editorial standards governing Reuters news reporting and multimedia output, specifying principles of independence, accuracy, neutrality, sourcing, conflict coverage, and correction/feedback procedures for newsroom staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence and Trust Principles
rubrics_metrics.description: Reuters news operations are based on the company's Trust Principles which stipulate that the integrity, independence and freedom from bias of Reuters must be upheld at all times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reuters has strict policies in place to ensure adherence to these principles; all reporting decisions should preserve editorial independence and freedom from bias.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accurate and balanced reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to accurate and balanced reporting. Errors of fact are always promptly corrected and clearly published.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reporters must prioritize factual accuracy and balance; when errors occur, they must be corrected promptly and published clearly (transparency about corrections).

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid emotive language
rubrics_metrics.description: We are committed to reporting the facts and in all situations avoid the use of emotive terms. The only exception is when we are quoting someone directly or in indirect speech.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write objectively about actions, identity and background; do not use emotionally loaded descriptors unless directly quoting a source.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objective reporting of actions, identity and background
rubrics_metrics.description: We aim to report objectively actions, identity and background and pay particular attention to all our coverage in extremely sensitive regions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure factual, non-sensational presentation of who did what and background context, with heightened care in sensitive or volatile areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not take sides; reflect all views
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not take sides and attempt to reflect in our stories, pictures and video the views of all sides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coverage should avoid favoritism or advocacy; include multiple perspectives where relevant and avoid presenting propaganda or one-sided narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not glorify parties or disseminate propaganda
rubrics_metrics.description: We are not in the business of glorifying one side or another or of disseminating propaganda.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid imagery, language or framing that glamorizes or promotes any party, cause or actor; critically assess information that may be propaganda.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journalists must not offer personal opinions
rubrics_metrics.description: Reuters journalists do not offer their own opinions or views.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain clear separation between reporting and personal commentary; reporters should not inject personal viewpoints into news stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear sourcing of accounts
rubrics_metrics.description: The world relies on Reuters journalists to provide accurate, clearly sourced accounts of events as they occur, wherever they occur, so that individuals, organisations and governments can make their own decisions based on the facts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute information clearly (who said what, official sources, eyewitnesses); ensure readers can assess the provenance of facts presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special caution in war and conflict coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Some Reuters coverage, including pictures and video, is of wars or conflicts during which all sides are actively promoting their positions and arguments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize the high risk of propaganda and misinformation in conflict zones; apply extra scrutiny to claims and context, and adhere strictly to neutrality and sourcing standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multimedia (pictures and video) follow same editorial standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Some Reuters coverage, including pictures and video, is of wars or conflicts ... We do not take sides and attempt to reflect in our stories, pictures and video the views of all sides.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat photos and video with the same requirements for balance, non-glorification and accurate context as text reporting; avoid using imagery that implicitly endorses a side.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback and corrections process
rubrics_metrics.description: We receive many hundreds of e-mails each week and it is not possible to send individual replies. But we do welcome views on how we could improve our news coverage and all correspondence is read by a senior editor. In fact we often spot and correct errors faster with the help of sharp-eyed readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourage reader feedback; have senior editorial oversight of correspondence; use reader input to identify and correct errors, while recognizing resource limits for individual responses.
